CustomField.description: Unified sub-bucket view across all stages. Auto-pulls from Sales Status, Pursuit Status, Hold Reason, or Loss Reason depending on Stage. Use this in reports and dashboards as a single column for cross-stage analysis.
CustomField.formula: CASE(TEXT(StageName), "On Hold", TEXT(Hold_Reason__c), "Closed Lost", TEXT(Loss_Reason__c), "PAL/ROE Complete", TEXT(Substatus__c), "Marketing/Bulk Complete", TEXT(Substatus__c), "Prospects", TEXT(Sales_Status__c), "Prospecting", TEXT(Sales_Status__c), "Engaged", TEXT(Sales_Status__c), "Proposal Sent", TEXT(Sales_Status__c), "Contract Negotiations", TEXT(Sales_Status__c), "" )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The sub-bucket within the current Stage. Read-only; auto-populates from the relevant reason field (Sales Status / Pursuit Status / Hold Reason / Loss Reason) based on Stage.
CustomField.label: Stage Status
